correctness.rationale: Cubic Lagrange interpolation gives the exact signed two-term difference recurrence. For four arbitrary positive step lengths, the three strict Schur--Jury numerators are degree-20 homogeneous integer polynomials with respective 271, 267 and 271 strictly positive nonzero coefficients. The complete coefficient table and two independently implemented exact reconstructions were checked. The nonuniform sharp limit is deduced from exact rational trace and determinant expansions. The proof is infinite-parameter, whereas the eight rational spot tests are only normalization cross-checks.

value.rationale: A complete unrestricted classification of all four positive recurring step lengths is a natural next-dimensional family in variable-step stability, not a sampled parameter slice. Large adjacent-ratio variations defeat common general sufficient conditions yet do not create a growing parasitic mode. The positive degree-20 exact certificate captures this nonobvious structure, and the sharp 1-6r near-neutral law quantifies an operationally important nonuniformity. No convergence or general-nonperiodic claim is made.
